lessons.title: Small apps retain the complete native recipe fallback
lessons.rationale: Keep the reliable native fallback for MVP and document selective recipe packaging before changing output semantics.

lessons.title: Evidence projection belongs to the product adapter
lessons.evidence: XTM-10 and XTM-11 reports have stable public schemas
lessons.rationale: Mapping report data into dashboard copy is product behavior, not a new framework primitive.

lessons.title: A dedicated KPI recipe is unnecessary
lessons.evidence: xtm-dashboard plus xtm-card composes all required KPI surfaces
lessons.rationale: Adding a special KPI recipe would duplicate existing composition and increase the public vocabulary.

lessons.title: Browser-direct hosts must install concrete product tokens
lessons.evidence: Initial QS rendered Canvas fallbacks through the operating-system dark color scheme
lessons.rationale: The Material pack consumes the public XTend token contract; choosing concrete enterprise-light values remains an application responsibility.

lessons.title: Browser evidence must reject unresolved visual fallbacks
lessons.evidence: The previous landmark-only screenshot gate passed while the product rendered system colors, an initially open dialog and a cropped nominal 390px headless viewport
lessons.rationale: The Catfooding browser gate now blocks unless computed product colors, light color scheme, initial dialog state, overflow and the browser's effective viewport match the declared visual contract.

lessons.title: Diagnostic runtime hosts must preserve product-shell navigation
lessons.evidence: The initial navigation correction kept links in the DOM, but anchor navigation scrolled the document-level sidebar out of the viewport because the workspace only declared min-height
lessons.rationale: The workspace now owns a viewport-bounded scroll container, only the primary slot scrolls, diagnostics retain full product links and the browser gate measures actual navigation visibility after every directly loaded SPA route.

lessons.title: HTML evidence projections must not impersonate an instrumented XTend app
lessons.evidence: The HTML-only dashboard exposed a partial __XTEND_DEV_API__ object and caused required-method errors in XTend DevTools
lessons.rationale: The projection now exposes no DEV API; the isolated Maraca runtime host owns a complete synchronous v1 adapter backed by current browser, Fabric, Kernel and Hydration state.

lessons.title: A flat runtime surface graph is diagnostics state, not an application layout
lessons.evidence: Rendering all 15 independently materialized RMT surfaces directly produced overlapping component shells, shadows and controls
lessons.rationale: The connected surface graph remains mounted in an inert one-pixel runtime boundary while a composed diagnostics dashboard presents live boot, surface and DEV API state without private component styling.
